title: The Lord's Prayer
original_text: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever and ever. Amen.
translated_text: Our Father, who art in heaven, hallowed be thy name. Thy kingdom come, thy will be done, on earth as it is in heaven. Give us this day our daily bread, and forgive us our trespasses, as we forgive those who trespass against us. And lead us not into temptation, but deliver us from evil. For thine is the kingdom, and the power, and the glory, forever and ever. Amen.

title: Serenity Prayer
original_text: God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, courage to change the things I can, and wisdom to know the difference.
translated_text: God, grant me the serenity to accept the things I cannot change, courage to change the things I can, and wisdom to know the difference.

title: Prayer of St. Francis
original_text: Lord, make me an instrument of your peace. Where there is hatred, let me sow love; where there is injury, pardon; where there is doubt, faith; where there is despair, hope; where there is darkness, light; where there is sadness, joy.
translated_text: Lord, make me an instrument of your peace. Where there is hatred, let me sow love; where there is injury, pardon; where there is doubt, faith; where there is despair, hope; where there is darkness, light; where there is sadness, joy.

title: Morning Prayer
original_text: This is the day which the Lord hath made; I will rejoice and be glad in it. O Lord, my God, I thank you for keeping me through the night. Guide my steps this day and let me walk in your light.
translated_text: This is the day which the Lord hath made; I will rejoice and be glad in it. O Lord, my God, I thank you for keeping me through the night. Guide my steps this day and let me walk in your light.

title: Evening Prayer
original_text: Now I lay me down to sleep, I pray the Lord my soul to keep. If I should die before I wake, I pray the Lord my soul to take. Amen.
translated_text: Now I lay me down to sleep, I pray the Lord my soul to keep. If I should die before I wake, I pray the Lord my soul to take. Amen.

title: Prayer for Peace
original_text: Lord, make me a channel of your peace. Where there is hatred, let me bring love. Where there is injury, let me bring pardon. Where there is discord, let me bring harmony. Where there is error, let me bring truth. Where there is doubt, let me bring faith. Where there is despair, let me bring hope.
translated_text: Lord, make me a channel of your peace. Where there is hatred, let me bring love. Where there is injury, let me bring pardon. Where there is discord, let me bring harmony.

title: Prayer for Healing
original_text: Lord, you are the great physician. I pray for your healing hand to be upon me and all who are suffering. Restore us to health and wholeness. Grant comfort and strength to those in pain.
translated_text: Lord, you are the great physician. I pray for your healing hand to be upon me and all who are suffering. Restore us to health and wholeness.

title: Prayer of Thanksgiving
original_text: We thank you, Lord, for all your blessings. For food and shelter, for family and friends, for health and strength, and for the gift of eternal life through your Son Jesus Christ. Amen.
translated_text: We thank you, Lord, for all your blessings. For food and shelter, for family and friends, for health and strength, and for the gift of eternal life through your Son Jesus Christ. Amen.

title: Prayer for Guidance
original_text: Lord, I need your guidance. Show me the way I should go, for I lift up my soul to you. Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Lead me in the land of uprightness.
translated_text: Lord, I need your guidance. Show me the way I should go, for I lift up my soul to you. Teach me to do your will, for you are my God. Lead me in the land of uprightness.

title: Prayer for Strength
original_text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. Lord, when I am weak, you are my strength. Be my refuge and my fortress, my God in whom I trust.
translated_text: I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. Lord, when I am weak, you are my strength. Be my refuge and my fortress, my God in whom I trust.
